text:
samir: kicking off region-by-region rollout for v2.1.3 today. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. tagging @lucy @charlie for capacity checks and @maya for oncall

DeployBot: DeployBot: starting preflight checks for v2.1.3...
- GPU pool US: 80% free
- GPU pool EU: 65% free
- GPU pool APAC: 42% free (warning)
- KV cache warm states: ok

lucy: ops note — APAC warm pool is 2 nodes right now; recommend +1 pre-APAC canary to avoid slow priming.

charlie: concur. Fallback pin: v2.1.2 for APAC if latency > 250ms or error_rate > 3% over 5m.

maya: add alert conds: error_rate > 3% OR p95_latency > 280ms sustained 3m triggers manual review/rollback.

samir: rollout plan detail:
- US: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% (15m between steps, watch 5m windows)
- EU: canary 5% -> 30% -> 100% (manual hold between canary/50%)
- APAC: manual hold after EU, wait for warm pool +1 and 10m of stable metrics

ops-bot: ops-bot: submitted reserve request: +1 g4dn to APAC warm pool. ETA ~12m. ticket #OPS-4729

DeployBot: DeployBot: canary deploy US started at 1718456789. canary id: can-20260321-71. monitoring: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv cache miss rate.

lucy: US initial smoke: p95 token latency 120ms, 5xx 0.2%. holding next ramp for 10m to let prefix caches fill.

samir: noted. remind teams to avoid synthetic cross-region traffic during warmup (could skew metrics).

charlie: question — enable quantized runtime in EU? last benchmark showed ~10% cost down, but +20ms p95.

maya: hold on quantization for EU until canary stable. prefer consistent latency for first pass.

ops-bot: ops-bot: APAC warm pool +1 completed. APAC free capacity now 62%.

DeployBot: DeployBot: US ramp to 50% complete, no regressions. next: schedule EU canary start in ~8m.

lucy: adding automated rollback rule: if region 5xx_rate > 1.5% AND api_error_ratio > 1.2x baseline for 3m -> auto-rollback to pinned version. Also post to #incidents.

samir: confirmed pinned fallback: v2.1.2 for all regions. Applied config: service/runtime:version=pinned:v2.1.2

charlie: release notes draft: "v2.1.3 — runtime perf fixes, KV cache handling improvements, smarter batching. Rolling out region-by-region; APAC will be manual hold until warm pool validation."

maya: I'll be oncall during APAC handoff. please escalate immediately on rollback trigger.

DeployBot: DeployBot: EU canary started at 1718456953. canary id: can-20260321-72.

lucy: EU initial metrics: p95 180ms, 5xx 0.6%. monitoring 10m.

samir: watch thermal metrics: if gpu_temp > 80C sustained 2m we will throttle batch sizes and pause rollout.

ops-bot: ops-bot: thermal readouts nominal across US/EU/APAC.

charlie: consensus: no quantization, hold APAC until green + warm pool. Manual rollback window open until 02:15 UTC.

maya: ack. will post to #eng-oncall if we flip rollback.

samir: thanks team. will post final status when APAC goes green and full ramp completes.
